artworks.alt: Figurative oil painting exploring form, flight, and weightless synchronicity
artworks.title: Flow
artworks.description: A compelling figurative study exploring themes of flight and anatomical synchronicity. Emerging from a warm, atmospheric haze, the layered, gestural contours of floating bodies convey a profound sense of shared momentum and weightless transition.

artworks.alt: Figurative oil painting exploring tension, surrender, and contrast of forms
artworks.title: Threshold
artworks.description: A striking oil on canvas study exploring the dualities of tension and surrender. The juxtaposition of a dynamic, arching form suspended against a quiet, curled silhouette captures a delicate balance between external release and internal contemplation.

artworks.alt: Figurative oil painting capturing a moment of lifting, suspension, and deep emotional support
artworks.title: Liftoff
artworks.description: An evocative oil painting capturing a profound moment of lifting and physical suspension. One figure arches gracefully overhead, supported intimately by the form below, creating a powerful narrative of trust, shared gravity, and emotional elevation against a deep, twilight background.

artworks.alt: Intent - Triptych oil painting exploring physical direction, alignment, and shared resolve
artworks.title: Intent
artworks.description: A powerful three-panel triptych exploring collective momentum and physical alignment. Across the expansive surface, fluid yet deliberate gestural forms interact with an underlying sense of shared purpose, mapping the body as both an anatomical structure and an emotional landscape of concentrated resolve.

artworks.alt: Gam Zeh Ya'avor I - Figurative oil painting
artworks.title: Gam Zeh Ya'avor I
artworks.description: An evocative figurative study grounding human form within a state of quiet transformation. Soft atmospheric layers and expressive brushwork reflect on impermanence, surrender, and enduring resilience.

artworks.alt: Gam Zeh Ya'avor II - Figurative oil painting
artworks.title: Gam Zeh Ya'avor II
artworks.description: A monumental continuation exploring the physical and emotional landscapes of form, transient energy, and quiet restoration.

artworks.alt: Hey - Oil on canvas macro study of human form and skin texture as landscape
artworks.title: Hey
artworks.description: An intimate, macro study of flesh and form. Soft palette tones paired with heavy, expressive surface texture transform a gesture into a quiet, monumental scene.

artworks.alt: Touch - Diptych oil painting exploring proximity, physical contact, and unspoken dialogue
artworks.title: Touch
artworks.description: An intimate diptych investigating the boundary of physical proximity and tactile contact. Spanning two interconnected panels, the atmospheric, layered contours capture the precise threshold where forms meet, translating an unspoken shared language of vulnerability and physical weightlessness.

artworks.alt: Enough - Oil on canvas painting exploring dynamic composition and expressive line work
artworks.title: Enough
artworks.description: An evocative oil on canvas study focusing on emotional depth through structural simplicity. The compact scale heightens the intimacy of the form, balancing minimalist negative space with highly intentional, expressive brushwork.

artworks.alt: Dynamic figurative charcoal sketch exploring form and movement
artworks.title: Charcoal Sketch Suspended Motion
artworks.description: A dynamic, expressive charcoal study exploring form and movement. Broad, textured strokes and sharp kinetic lines blend figurative elements with abstract energy, creating a powerful sense of weightlessness.

artworks.alt: Powerful vertical figurative charcoal sketch with ascending figures
artworks.title: Charcoal Sketch Fractured Gravity
artworks.description: A compelling vertical charcoal study depicting layered, ascending forms. Sharp gestural marks and heavy, cross-hatched shading create an intense sense of physical momentum, struggle, and emotional release.

artworks.alt: Expressive charcoal sketch showing rich texture and broken geometric marks
artworks.title: Charcoal Sketch Shifting Ground
artworks.description: A powerful, deeply textured charcoal study characterized by bold gestural lines and dense, geometric shading. Sharp, energetic markings slice across fluid bodily contours, creating a striking sense of internal friction, fragmentation, and raw physical movement.

artworks.alt: Dynamic figurative charcoal sketch exploring momentum and forward intent
artworks.title: Charcoal Sketch Go
artworks.description: A powerful work driven by bold gestural lines and deep kinetic markings. The piece emphasizes structural force and immediate physical intent, pulling forms into a state of continuous transition.

artworks.alt: Figurative charcoal sketch exploring alignment and gestural weightlessness
artworks.title: Charcoal Sketch Them
artworks.description: An expressive charcoal study focusing on swift, delicate lines and the interplay of negative space. The raw texture captures a transient moment of equilibrium and shared physical momentum.

artworks.title: Becoming
artworks.description: An exploration of women, resilience, and transformation. Folded arms and legs speak to what we carry, shed, and survive—reflecting a land and its people in a state of change, renewal, and becoming.
